title: boardping — school-board agenda alerts for K-12 IT and security vendors
oneLiner: For small MSPs and cybersecurity firms selling to K-12 districts in one state, it reads school-board agendas and bid pages and emails a weekly digest of IT buying signals, each with a quoted source, weeks before the RFP is posted.
overlaps: permitly (watches city ordinance pages for rental operators) and lienclock (deadline alerts for subcontractors) — same watch-and-alert pattern, different buyer and data; no existing repo covers government-sales leads
